After months of testing Liquid Glass, WhatsApp is gradually expanding access to its redesigned iPad app interface, including a brand new Mac-style sidebar. Here's what you need to know.

WhatsApp is developing a brand new iPad app interface

WhatsApp began developing a major Liquid Glass visual overhaul for its iOS app as early as last October, but the company later brought this redesign to the iPad first, starting limited beta testing in June.

At the time, WABetaInfo reported that this redesign included Liquid Glass-styled tabs, buttons and action menus, while retaining the familiar bottom tab bar found on iPhone.

WABetaInfo now reports that WhatsApp is rolling out another major interface change for some iPad users, replacing the default bottom tab bar with a brand new Mac-style sidebar.

This sidebar mimics the layout of the existing WhatsApp Mac app, providing quick access to chats, status updates, communities, calls, Meta AI and other app sections. Users can also collapse it to give more display space to the conversation list and chat windows.

WABetaInfo reports as follows:

WABetaInfo notes that some beta testers in the latest TestFlight build can already use the new sidebar, and some users on the regular App Store version are also beginning to see this change.

As is WhatsApp's usual practice, the new interface may take some time to roll out to all users, whether they're on the beta or the official version. However, once iPad users receive the update, they can enjoy a layout better suited to tablet use.
